audit_scope.description: This batch covers EL internals: Cancun VM bitwise operations, Prague stack operations, Spurious Dragon fork activation (EIP-607 with EIP-155/160/161/170), network upgrade references (EIP-7568), and Byzantium block state transition pipeline.

misclassified_entities.reason: A transaction is data submitted by an external sender, but 'Transaction Execution' as modeled in EIP-607's state-clearing subgraph is an internal process, not an external entity. The actual external entity is the transaction sender.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Producer (Miner) via P2P
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P block propagation (triggering Spurious Dragon fork activation)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Miners submit blocks over unauthenticated P2P network. Blocks must be fully validated including fork activation rules, EIP-155 chain ID, EIP-170 code size limits.

trusted_external_entities.name: Replay Attacker via Transaction Submission
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Attacker attempts to replay transactions from other chains (e.g., ETC). Completely untrusted. EIP-155 chain ID verification must reject these.

trusted_external_entities.name: User via Transaction Submission
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Users submit signed transactions. No authentication beyond signature verification. Transaction must be fully validated: nonce, balance, gas, chain ID, sender is EOA.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer via P2P Block Propagation
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P block reception for Byzantium state transition pipeline
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers propagate blocks over unauthenticated P2P. Full block validation required: header, ommers, transaction execution, root hash verification.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Sender via Signed Transaction
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Transaction inclusion in block (validated via ECDSA signature recovery)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External accounts submit transactions. Sender is authenticated via ECDSA but all transaction content must be validated: intrinsic gas, nonce, balance, EOA check.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Miner via PoW Submission
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Miners submit blocks with PoW. Must verify: Ethash PoW validity, difficulty matches formula (including 3M block bomb delay), block reward is 3 ETH.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block number must be checked against SPURIOUS_DRAGON_FORK_BLKNUM (2,675,000). Fork rules (EIP-155, 160, 161, 170) must be applied atomically at fork block. Invalid blocks must be rejected.
Chain ID must be extracted from transaction signature v-value and verified against network chain ID. Transactions with mismatched chain ID must be rejected to prevent cross-chain replay attacks.
Full transaction validation required: ECDSA signature recovery, chain ID verification (post-Spurious Dragon), nonce match, balance sufficiency, gas availability.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Byzantium block validation pipeline (header → ommers → body → roots)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Complete block validation pipeline must be executed: header validation (sequential numbering, timestamp, gas limit, difficulty, parent hash), ommer validation (max 2, no duplicates, age 1-6), transaction execution, root hash verification (state, tx, receipt, bloom).

Transaction sender must be recovered via ECDSA, nonce must match exactly, balance must cover gas*price + value, sender must be EOA (no code). Gas refund capped at 50% of consumed gas. Empty accounts cleaned post-execution.

PoW must be validated via hashimoto_light(). Result must satisfy difficulty target: result_as_uint <= 2^256 / difficulty. Difficulty must be computed with 3M block bomb delay. Block reward must be 3 ETH with correct ommer reward formula.
